lessons.title: hello
lessons.tip: there is no word for am / is / are in the present. "mi ana" just means "I am Ana". ka at the very end turns a sentence into a yes/no question.

lessons.title: mother and father
lessons.tip: da means "of", and it comes after the thing: "ama da mi" is "mother of me", so "my mother".

lessons.title: brothers and sisters
lessons.tip: the verb always goes last. "mi bro ha" is "I brother have". sa means he, she and it.

sentences.e: I have a brother and a sister.

lessons.title: more than one
lessons.tip: plural: add -n after a vowel (kiti, kitin) and -an after a consonant. after a number the noun stays as it is: dor bro, two brothers.

lessons.title: my family
lessons.tip: adjectives come after the noun. with no verb they make the whole sentence: "folka gran" is "the family is big".

lessons.title: at home
lessons.tip: little words like un (in) go before the noun: "un kar", in the house. question words sit where the answer goes.

sentences.e: we live in a big house.

lessons.title: dinner together
lessons.tip: ne (not) goes right before the verb. tot after a noun means all of it: "folka tot", the whole family.

sentences.e: the child does not eat the food.

lessons.title: holidays
lessons.tip: ra means "to": you give something ra someone.

sentences.e: mother gives a gift to me.
I give a gift to grandmother.
in the evening, grandmother tells stories.

lessons.title: we love each other
lessons.tip: mol (very) goes right before the word it makes stronger.

sentences.v: tu folka da tu liva ka?

lessons.title: numbers
lessons.tip: es (to be) also means "there is / there are". numbers go before the noun.

sentences.e: how much does the apple cost?
no, I do not have money.
in the morning, I eat breakfast.
do you want coffee or tea?
the plate is on the table.
the knife is in the kitchen.
the plates are on the table.
the fruit is sweet and good.

lessons.title: please and thank you
lessons.tip: to tell someone to do something, leave out tu: just say the object and the verb. put kiro (please) in front to be nice.

sentences.e: the whole family likes the cake.

sentences.v: kar da mi tis rum ha.

sentences.e: the bed is in the room.
the window is big and beautiful.
the gray cat is on the bed.
the child sleeps in the bed.
the dog is under the table.
the chair is next to the bed.
the cat is behind the door.
the house is in front of the tree.

lessons.title: my room
lessons.tip: with no verb, ne goes before the adjective: "lum ne bon", the light is not good.

sentences.v: rum da mi pik shom bela.
sentences.e: my room is small but beautiful.
the lamp is on the table.
there are many books in the closet.
I get up in the morning.

lessons.title: evening
lessons.tip: want, like and can go after the other verb: "mi nema vola" is "I want to sleep".

sentences.e: in the evening, we play a game.
the child is in the bath.
after school, I play a game.
before dinner, we wash our hands.

sentences.v: un fin da dey, mi nema.
sentences.e: at the end of the day, I sleep.

sections.title: out in the world
sections.subtitle: the city, nature, school and work

sentences.e: the city is big and beautiful.
there are many cars on the street.

lessons.title: yesterday
lessons.tip: past tense: add -ta to the verb. gol (go) becomes golta (went). kel means with, and also "by" for travel.

sentences.e: yesterday I went to the city.
the shop is next to the park.
I want to go to the museum.
yesterday they played in the park.
they traveled to a new country.

lessons.title: tomorrow
lessons.tip: future tense: add -va to the verb. gol becomes golva (will go).

sentences.e: tomorrow I will go to the mountain.
he will come to the hotel.
the shop is on the left side.
the hotel is on the right side.
the museum is ten minutes away.
the train will go for two hours.
I got lost in the city.
I did not find the hotel.
the sea is blue and beautiful.

sentences.v: tu foton da mi goda ka?

sentences.e: the sun is in the sky.
at night, there are many stars.

lessons.title: weather
lessons.tip: weather verbs have no subject: "pluva" alone means "it rains".

sentences.e: the river goes to the lake.
a red flower is next to the tree.
the mountain is big and white.

lessons.title: bigger and best
lessons.tip: add -or (-r after a vowel) for "more": gran, granor. add -esh (-sh after a vowel) for "most": granesh. "than" is dë.

sentences.e: the mountain is bigger than the house.
the river is longer than the road.
this flower is more beautiful than that one.
this lake is the most beautiful.
the birds fly in the sky.
the fish lives in the water.
the horse is faster than the dog.
the bear lives in the forest.
the wolf is bigger than the cat.

sentences.v: un somër, min ra pelag gol.
sentences.e: in summer, we go to the sea.
the horses run in the field.

lessons.title: how you do it
lessons.tip: add -mo to an adjective to say how something is done: rap (fast), rapmo (quickly).

sentences.e: do not leave trash in the forest!
tomorrow we will make the river clean.
we had a picnic in the park.
this was the most beautiful day.

lessons.title: can, must, want
lessons.tip: can (pot), must (deba) and want (vola) come after the main verb, and they take the -ta or -va: "mi gol potta", I could go.

sentences.e: the teacher writes on the board.
I have a pen and paper.

lessons.title: first, second, third
lessons.tip: add -i to a number for first, second...: ek, eki. clock time is or + the number: "un or okh", at eight o'clock.

sentences.e: this is the first day of school.
tomorrow there will be a test.
I will finish the homework after dinner.

lessons.title: jobs
lessons.tip: add -ri to a verb for the person who does it: lira (sing), lirari (singer).

lessons.title: days of the week
lessons.tip: the days are numbered: dey eki (first day) is monday, dey sibi (seventh day) is sunday.

sentences.e: on Monday, I go to school.
on Friday, we will have a party.
last month, I worked a lot.

sentences.v: yer pros, mi ra skol nov golva.
sentences.e: next year, I will go to a new school.
she has a lot of time.

lessons.title: a busy week
lessons.tip: ve (this) and vo (that) go before the noun, like numbers: ve vek, this week.

sentences.e: on Monday, I have a test.

sentences.v: dey tisi, mi kel vren ludava.
sentences.e: on Wednesday, I will play with a friend.
this week, I am very busy.
but on Sunday, I am free.

sections.title: talking for real
sections.subtitle: feelings, stories, hobbies and big ideas

sentences.e: the child is scared at night.

lessons.title: because
lessons.tip: kaus (because) starts a second part of the sentence. every part keeps its verb at the end.

sentences.v: mi tris, kaus vren da mi dalë.
sentences.e: I am sad because my friend is far away.

sentences.v: sa fela, kaus sa dara ha.
sentences.e: she is happy because she has a gift.
we did not go because it rained.

sentences.v: mi dor braso i dor pedë ha.
sentences.e: I have two arms and two legs.
I have to stay in bed.

lessons.title: if
lessons.tip: sef (if) works like kaus: the if part comes first and ends with its verb, then the rest.

sentences.v: sef tu sika, ra medik gol.
sentences.e: if you are sick, go to the doctor.

sentences.v: sef pluva, min un kar resta.
sentences.e: if it rains, we stay at home.

sentences.v: sef mi kron ha, mi tu aydava.
sentences.e: if I have time, I will help you.

sentences.v: sef sol shina, min ra pelag golva.
sentences.e: if the sun shines, we will go to the sea.
if you are happy, I am happy.

lessons.title: when
lessons.tip: kwan is also "when" in the middle of a sentence: the when part comes first.

sentences.v: kwan mi pik esta, mi un ferma vivata.
sentences.e: when I was small, I lived on a farm.

sentences.v: kwan tu venva, min kun yamava.
sentences.e: when you come, we will eat together.

sentences.v: kwan pluva, mish un kar resta.
sentences.e: when it rains, the cat stays at home.
when she is happy, she sings.
when grandfather comes, the children are happy.

sentences.v: yordo, ek rey un kastë vivata.
sentences.e: long ago, a king lived in a castle.
a big dragon came to the castle.
the dragon did not eat the king.
the dragon and the king were friends!

lessons.title: who and that
lessons.tip: ki starts a description of the noun before it, and the description ends with its own verb: "hum ki ik viva", the person who lives here.

sentences.e: the person who lives here is good.

sentences.v: mi vren ki vendëri thela ha.
sentences.e: I have a friend who speaks Venderian.

sentences.v: kitë ki tu predey kopata mol bon.
sentences.e: the book that you bought yesterday is very good.

sentences.v: drako ki un bor viva gran.
sentences.e: the dragon that lives on the mountain is big.
the person who helped me is a doctor.
in the end, everyone lived happily.

sentences.v: mi sagon ki drakon ha goda.
sentences.e: I like stories that have dragons.
the children heard the whole story.
I like to listen to music.
the singer has a beautiful voice.
we will go to the concert.

lessons.title: I think that
lessons.tip: ke is the one thing that comes after the verb: "mi penka ke ...", I think that ... the part after ke has its own verb at the end.

sentences.e: I think that music is good.

sentences.v: sa thelata ke sa posdey venva.
sentences.e: she said that she will come tomorrow.

sentences.v: mi kenë ke tu gitar luda pot.
sentences.e: I know that you can play the guitar.

sentences.v: tu penka ke ve lir bela ka?
sentences.e: do you think that this song is beautiful?
we heard that the band is new.
what are the rules of the game?
this game is easier than that one.
I want to play the game again.
in the end, the fans were happy.
if you train, you will win.

sentences.v: medik thelata ke mi trena deba.
sentences.e: the doctor said that I have to train.
today there is a big game.

sentences.v: ekipa da mi trenata i trenata.

sentences.e: I think that we will win.

sentences.v: un fin, ekipa da min vinata!
sentences.e: in the end, our team won!

sentences.v: ve dey bonesh da yer esta.
sentences.e: this was the best day of the year.
I believe that this is true.
she said that this is false.

sentences.v: mi konsa, kaus ve ideya bon.
sentences.e: I agree because this idea is good.

lessons.title: big words
lessons.tip: add -tal to an adjective to make it a thing: fela (happy), felatal (happiness).

sentences.e: I love the beauty of the sea.
the world is big and beautiful.

sentences.v: avenë da mundo un khanan da min es.
sentences.e: the future of the world is in our hands.
I want to travel the whole world.

sentences.v: lerna thelor nov khar, shom bon.
sentences.e: learning a new language is hard but good.

sentences.v: un noch, mi sonyata ke mi alata.
sentences.e: at night, I dreamed that I flew.
I want to be a famous singer.

sentences.v: sef tu kreda, sonyo da tu ver esva.
sentences.e: if you believe, your dream will come true.

sentences.v: mi dey eki da skol rekorda.
sentences.e: I remember the first day of school.

sentences.v: tu ishe da mi oblidata ka?
kwan mi kiti esta, mi un noch timë esta.
sentences.e: when I was a child, I was scared at night.

sentences.v: memo da dedo sempo un kor da mi es.
sentences.e: the memory of grandfather is always in my heart.

sentences.v: un avenë, human sur mera vivava.
sentences.e: in the future, people will live on the moon.

sentences.v: mi penka ke avenë bon esva.
sentences.e: I think that the future will be good.
what will you do in the future?
I am good, thanks. and you?

sentences.v: mi mol fela, kaus mi vendëri lerna.
sentences.e: I am very happy because I am learning Venderian.

sentences.v: dey tot trena, i ne oblida!
sentences.e: practice every day, and do not forget!
Venderian is the most beautiful language.
